name: Cyberpunk 2077: Turf Wars
summary: IAAPA Brass Ring Award-winning Cyberpunk 2077: Turf Wars delivers an unforgettable arcade experience, blending CD PROJEKT RED’s iconic world with innovative gameplay. Projection mapping merges vivid visuals with physical targets for explosive, high-energy combat. The patented Blast Shooting Effect lights up the battlefield with dazzling bursts, enhanced by haptic feedback and a powerful soundtrack. With three modes—Story, Co-Op/Versus, and Sniper Mode—players can tackle missions, team up, or test their precision. Designed for operators, Turf Wars offers remote game management for easy monitoring and updates. Backed by the Cyberpunk 2077 brand, it’s a standout attraction built to boost engagement and revenue.
